name: To-do
description: Tasks with due dates, reminders, priorities, repeats and steps.

create.description: Create a task. Dates, times, #tags, !priority and "every week" in the title are understood ("Call Sam tomorrow 6pm #work !high"); due (YYYY-MM-DD), remind_time (HH:MM), priority (0-3), repeat, tags and notes may also be given. Optional in_progress, urgent and important booleans.

title.description: Task title; may include a date, time, #tags, !priority and "every week".

remind_time.description: Reminder time (HH:MM) on the due date; without a due date it means the next time it comes round.

repeat.description: How the task repeats; never (or empty) for no repeat.

in_progress.description: Task is being worked on (Doing lane).

update.description: Change a task's title, notes, due, remind_time, priority (0-3), repeat (daily, weekdays, weekly, monthly) or tags; empty clears. Also accepts in_progress, urgent and important (booleans).

remind_time.description: Reminder time (HH:MM); empty clears. Sets the due date to today if there is none.

repeat.description: How the task repeats; never (or empty) for no repeat.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags, replacing the current ones; empty clears.

in_progress.description: Task is being worked on (Doing lane).

toggle.description: Mark a task done or not done. Finishing a repeating task creates the next one. Returns ask_note (the task id) when a note should be offered.

done.description: true to mark done, false to reopen.

delete.confirm: Move this task to the trash?

restore.description: Bring a task back from trash.

completed_between.description: Tasks completed between local dates start and end (inclusive), with their notes.

clear_done.description: Hide finished tasks from the lists (they still count in reviews).
clear_done.confirm: Hide all finished tasks from the lists?

add_step.description: Add a step (task_id, title) to a task.

task_id.description: The task to add the step to.

toggle_step.description: Tick or untick a step (id, done).

done.description: true to tick, false to untick.

save_note.description: Save what came of a finished task (id, text); also kept in Notes under the Tasks project. Empty text removes it from the task.

text.description: What came of the task; empty removes the note.

examples.text: Sam agreed to Friday; sent the invite.

note_settings.description: When to offer a note on finishing a task: ask (always, tagged, never) and tags (for tagged).

ask.description: When to offer a note on finishing a task (default always).

tags.description: Comma-separated tags whose tasks ask for a note; required when ask is tagged.

open_tasks.description: Open tasks for reviews: overdue, due up to end (YYYY-MM-DD, default a week from today), and undated.

today.description: Override today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the overdue cut-off.

end.description: Include tasks due up to this date (default a week from today).

focus_suggestions.sql: WITH RECURSIVE s(tag, rest) AS (SELECT '', tags || ', ' FROM tasks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND cleared_at IS NULL AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags <> '' UNION ALL SELECT trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ', ') - 1)), substr(rest, instr(rest, ', ') + 2) FROM s WHERE rest <> '') SELECT tag AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM s WHERE tag <> '' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY count DESC, tag LIMIT 30
focus_suggestions.description: Tags in use on current tasks, most used first.

tasks.sql: SELECT id, title, notes, due, tags, COALESCE(in_progress, 0) AS in_progress, COALESCE(urgent, 0) AS urgent, COALESCE(important, 0) AS important, CASE WHEN done = 1 THEN 'done' WHEN in_progress = 1 THEN 'doing' ELSE 'todo' END AS board_lane, CASE WHEN in_progress = 1 THEN 'Move to To do' ELSE 'Start task' END AS move_label, CASE WHEN urgent = 1 AND important = 1 THEN 'do' WHEN important = 1 THEN 'schedule' WHEN urgent = 1 THEN 'delegate' ELSE 'eliminate' END AS matrix_lane, COALESCE(priority, 0) AS priority, repeat, remind_time, done, CASE WHEN due IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN d = 0 THEN 'Today' WHEN d = 1 THEN 'Tomorrow' WHEN d = -1 THEN 'Yesterday' WHEN d BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN CASE strftime('%w', due) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', due) AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', due) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(due, 1, 4) <> substr(?1, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(due, 1, 4) ELSE '' END END || CASE WHEN remind_time IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || remind_time ELSE '' END AS due_label, CASE WHEN done = 0 AND d < 0 THEN 'danger' WHEN done = 0 AND d = 0 THEN 'accent' END AS due_tone, CASE WHEN done = 1 THEN 'Completed' WHEN due IS NULL THEN 'No date' WHEN d < 0 THEN 'Overdue' WHEN d = 0 THEN 'Today' WHEN d = 1 THEN 'Tomorrow' WHEN d <= 6 THEN CASE strftime('%w', due) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' ELSE 'Saturday' END ELSE 'Later' END AS section, CASE WHEN done = 0 AND d < 0 THEN 'danger' END AS section_tone, CASE repeat WHEN 'daily' THEN 'Daily' WHEN 'weekdays' THEN 'Weekdays' WHEN 'weekly' THEN 'Weekly' WHEN 'monthly' THEN 'Monthly' END AS repeat_label, CASE WHEN steps_total > 0 THEN steps_done || '/' || steps_total END AS steps_label, CASE WHEN done_note IS NOT NULL THEN 'Note' END AS note_chip FROM (SELECT t.*, CAST(julianday(t.due) - julianday(?1) AS INTEGER) AS d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM steps s WHERE s.task_id = t.id AND s._deleted IS NULL) AS steps_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM steps s WHERE s.task_id = t.id AND s._deleted IS NULL AND s.done = 1) AS steps_done FROM tasks t WHERE t._deleted IS NULL AND t.cleared_at IS NULL) WHERE (?3 IS NULL OR ?3 = '' OR title LIKE '%' || ?3 || '%' OR tags LIKE '%' || ?3 || '%' OR notes LIKE '%' || ?3 || '%') AND (?4 IS NULL OR ?4 = '' OR EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE f(tag, rest) AS (SELECT '', ?4 || ',' UNION ALL SELECT lower(ltrim(trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1)), '#')), substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1) FROM f WHERE rest <> '') SELECT 1 FROM f WHERE tag <> '' AND instr(', ' || lower(COALESCE(tags, '')) || ', ', ', ' || tag || ', ') > 0)) AND CASE ?2 WHEN 'today' THEN done = 0 AND (due IS NULL OR d <= 0) WHEN 'upcoming' THEN done = 0 AND d > 0 WHEN 'done' THEN done = 1 WHEN 'everything' THEN 1 ELSE done = 0 END ORDER BY CASE WHEN done = 1 THEN 6 WHEN due IS NULL THEN 5 WHEN d < 0 THEN 0 WHEN d = 0 THEN 1 WHEN d <= 6 THEN 2 ELSE 4 END, due, COALESCE(priority, 0) DESC, CASE WHEN done = 1 THEN -completed_at END, id DESC LIMIT 500
tasks.description: List tasks with due labels, steps progress and board/matrix lanes.

filter.description: Which tasks: today (open, due today/overdue or undated), upcoming (open, due later), done, everything; any other value (e.g. open or empty) means all open tasks.

q.description: Text to find in title, tags or notes.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags; tasks with any of them match (# optional).

trash.sql: SELECT id, title FROM tasks WHERE _deleted IS NOT NULL ORDER BY _deleted DESC LIMIT 100
trash.description: Tasks in the trash, most recently deleted first.

summary.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(done = 0 AND (due IS NULL OR due <= ?1)), 0) AS today, COALESCE(SUM(done = 0 AND due < ?1), 0) AS overdue, COALESCE(SUM(done = 0), 0) AS open FROM tasks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND cleared_at IS NULL
summary.description: Counts of tasks for today, overdue and open.

badge.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM tasks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND done = 0 AND due IS NOT NULL AND due <= ?1
badge.description: Number of open tasks due today or overdue.

search.sql: SELECT id, title, CASE WHEN done = 1 THEN 'Done' ELSE COALESCE(due, tags) END AS subtitle FROM tasks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND cleared_at IS NULL AND (title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR notes LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR tags LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') ORDER BY done, due IS NULL, due LIMIT 8
search.description: Find tasks by title, notes or tags (for global search).

task.sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.in_progress, 0) AS in_progress, COALESCE(t.urgent, 0) AS urgent, COALESCE(t.important, 0) AS important, t.id, t.title, COALESCE(t.notes, '') AS notes, t.due, COALESCE(t.tags, '') AS tags, COALESCE(t.priority, 0) AS priority, COALESCE(t.repeat, '') AS repeat, t.remind_time, t.done, CASE WHEN t.done = 1 THEN 'Mark not done' ELSE 'Mark done' END AS done_label, COALESCE(t.done_note, '') AS done_note, t.done = 1 AS can_note, (SELECT p.done_note FROM tasks p WHERE p._deleted IS NULL AND p.id <> t.id AND p.done = 1 AND p.done_note IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.series, p.id) = COALESCE(t.series, t.id) ORDER BY p.completed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_note, (SELECT 'Last time (' || date(p.completed_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') || ')' FROM tasks p WHERE p._deleted IS NULL AND p.id <> t.id AND p.done = 1 AND p.done_note IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.series, p.id) = COALESCE(t.series, t.id) ORDER BY p.completed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_note_title FROM tasks t WHERE t.id = ?1 AND t._deleted IS NULL
task.description: One task with its details and the note from its last completion.

steps.sql: SELECT id, title, done FROM steps WHERE task_id = ?1 AND _deleted IS NULL ORDER BY id

counts.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(done = 0 AND (due IS NULL OR due <= ?1)), 0) AS today, COALESCE(SUM(done = 0 AND due > ?1), 0) AS upcoming, COALESCE(SUM(done = 0), 0) AS open, COALESCE(SUM(done = 1), 0) AS done FROM tasks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND cleared_at IS NULL
counts.description: Counts of tasks for today, upcoming, open and done.

due_reminders.sql: SELECT id, remind_at AS at_ms, title, CASE WHEN notes IS NOT NULL THEN substr(notes, 1, 120) ELSE 'To-do reminder' END AS body, 'both' AS notify_on FROM tasks WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND done = 0 AND remind_at IS NOT NULL AND remind_at >= ?1
due_reminders.description: Pending task reminders for the reminder scheduler.

note_settings.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT ask_note FROM settings WHERE _deleted IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 'always') AS ask, COALESCE((SELECT note_tags FROM settings WHERE _deleted IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), '') AS tags
note_settings.description: Current settings for offering a note on finishing a task.
